defect.name: freshness_gate_required_non_executable_complement_tokens
defect.description: NegRisk complete sets, conversions, logical relations and publish-time revalidation required complementary market tokens that did not enter the priced/executable basket. Under sparse full-WS lineage this can suppress otherwise valid hard-arbitrage evaluation.
defect.safety_interpretation: Freshness remains fail-closed on every token that is actually priced or executed. The repair removes only irrelevant complementary-outcome requirements; it does not weaken age, skew, full-WS or reconnect guards.

repair_contract: Binary complete-set requires YES and NO.
NegRisk complete-set requires only member YES legs.
Each NegRisk conversion requires source NO plus target YES legs.
Implication requires antecedent NO plus consequent YES.
Mutual exclusion requires two NO legs.
Exhaustive pair requires two YES legs.
Publish-time revalidation uses actual opportunity leg token IDs.
Per-leg maximum exchange age remains 5000 ms.
Cross-leg exchange/receive skew remains bounded at 1500 ms.
Only a full WS snapshot can establish gap-free L2 lineage; reconnect invalidates it.
required_next_evidence: Exact-head CI and Research Policy green on this current-main port.
Exact-head Fast Shadow on public data.
Compare hard-hit recall and freshness reject counters to run 33030273187.
Any recovered hard hit still requires authoritative fee/depth economics, sequential PAPER legging/partial/unwind, canonical-ledger realized PnL and 1x/1.5x/2x stress before an alpha claim.
